text: Sipho, did you get your parcel from the gate?
No. The security man says it is at the desk. I will go down tomorrow.
Ok. They usually keep them at the desk till 6 I think
Yes, I was told that also.
wait is that the one from takealot?? 📦 i think thats mine lol
The box on the desk has my name on it. It is not yours.
my bad. ill check the app
Mine was supposed to come today too 🙄 ill go down in the morning
ok guard told me the desk is closed after 18:00 anyway so we're late lol
just checked the app. mine is out for delivery tmrw
Desk is open. I have my box. Going back up.
Zanele, yours is also on the desk. I saw the name on it.
Ok thanks. Ill go down after my 9 call
They close at six. Go before lunch.
Ya ok
morning is the delivery guy coming to the flat or the desk? thats the question lol
The app says the desk if no one answers. Ask the guard, not the app.
ok bet
[photo: parcel with one corner crushed]
They really didnt try
Take it back and ask for a note. Mine was fine.
Lol ok
Is the water off on your side? Nothing since four.
Yes its off here too. Think its the whole block
I rang the number on the board. Nobody picks up.
[photo: parcel on the doorstep] delivered finally lol
water is off here too btw 💀
There is a notice on the board now. Repair on the main. Back tonight they say.
water back finally lol
Water is running in my kitchen. Brown for a minute, then clear.
Let it run before you drink it. The board says boil if it is cloudy.
Ok good. Mine is also brown 😩 running it now
Ill boil just in case
Boil one minute, then let it cool. Only for drinking.
morning all 🙏 water is clear here now
boiled it tho just in case 😭 this kettle is so loud lol
The notice says the main is being fixed properly on Sunday. Water off again from 8 to 10 they say.
Fill buckets tonight.
Ya I saw. Ill fill the bath
Not drinking from it lol
on my break at the mall, food court is packed 💀 anyone need anything from the pharmacy here?
Can you check if they have the 3 pin adaptor, mine broke
i think so 🙏 ill check and send pic
[photo: adaptor on a shelf at the pharmacy]
they have 2 left
Ok ill come grab them later
The lift is also off. Sign on the door says Monday.
I took the stairs with my shopping. Not again.
shift done finally 😩 going to my cousins in soweto, back late
Filled the bath Ill be up late doing a logo so dont knock lol
Lock your doors. The gate was open when I came back.
back home. water still ok 💀
